body:
on the back: “saturday before sunrise, waxy pollen on the weathered bundle after the fertilizer trial. our cat would not drink from the water bowl; a pale film sat on top. the seedlings by the fence went limp by noon.”

A pencil line had been rubbed thin but not erased. I could still read enough of it to see which field the trial had been in.

It may have started elsewhere; none of us saw the beginning. I only know what had reached our rows by then.
title: weathered bundle note — saturday before sunrise

body: They gathered here after the road was closed, and someone carefully counted every person present. The official tally for this stretch was zero. The woman with the candles made a second list on the back of a wrapper.
title: Names after the candles
